# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 10 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 21 tokens; Borders and rings — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 13 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 6 tokens; Shadow — 6 tokens; State — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--background);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (10)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `background` | #ffffff | #131313 | Latar aplikasi, putih bersih. |
| `surface` | #ffffff | #131313 | Latar halaman, kartu, sheet, dan bar. Putih murni di tema terang. |
| `surface-variant` | #f1f1f1 | #303030 | Latar field pencarian dan blok abu netral. |
| `surface-dim` | #dadada | #131313 | Latar paling redup untuk area yang mundur. |
| `surface-bright` | #ffffff | #353535 | Surface paling terang. |
| `surface-container-lowest` | #ffffff | #0e0e0e | Kartu di atas latar abu. |
| `surface-container-low` | #f9f9f9 | #191919 | Latar section abu sangat tipis yang memisahkan kelompok konten. |
| `surface-container` | #f3f3f3 | #1d1d1d | Latar halaman alternatif saat konten utama berupa kartu putih. |
| `surface-container-high` | #eeeeee | #262626 | Track progress, skeleton loading. |
| `surface-container-highest` | #e8e8e8 | #303030 | Track switch mati, latar field disabled. |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-display-large);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display-large` | `.display-large`, `--text-display-large` | 44px / 56px | 800 | `sans` | Angka hero, satu per layar. |
| `display-medium` | `.display-medium`, `--text-display-medium` | 34px / 44px | 800 | `sans` | Angka atau judul hero di layar sambutan. |
| `display-small` | `.display-small`, `--text-display-small` | 28px / 36px | 800 | `sans` | Judul hero di kartu besar. |

| `headline-medium` | `.headline-medium`, `--text-headline-medium` | 22px / 28px | 700 | `sans` | Judul layar di ponsel. |
| `headline-small` | `.headline-small`, `--text-headline-small` | 20px / 28px | 700 | `sans` | Judul section, judul dialog dan bottom sheet. |

## Spacing

Grid 4dp. Compose: nilai Dp yang sama.

### Use

```css
padding: var(--space-4);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space-4` | 4px | Jarak ikon dan label di dalam chip; jarak label dan field. |
| `space-8` | 8px | Jarak antar-chip dan antar-elemen kecil sebaris. |
| `space-12` | 12px | Jarak antar-kartu dalam grid; padding vertikal list item. |
| `space-16` | 16px | Margin sisi layar ponsel; padding kartu; jarak antar-field. |
| `space-20` | 20px | Padding kartu hero dan bottom sheet. |
| `space-24` | 24px | Jarak antar-section; margin sisi tablet dan web. |
| `space-32` | 32px | Jarak antar-blok besar halaman. |
| `space-48` | 48px | Tinggi tombol dan target sentuh minimal. |

## Radius

Bentuk IRIS: lebih bulat dan tebal dari M3 default.

### Use

```css
/* var(--shape-xs) */
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `shape-xs` | 6px | Checkbox, badge kotak, tag kecil. |
| `shape-sm` | 8px | Thumbnail kecil, snackbar. |
| `shape-md` | 12px | Field input, tile ikon kategori, menu. |
| `shape-lg` | 16px | Kartu, FAB, kartu aksen. |
| `shape-xl` | 24px | Dialog, bottom sheet (sudut atas), kartu hero. |
| `shape-full` | 9999px | Tombol, chip, switch, badge angka, avatar. |

## Shadow

Elevasi IRIS memakai bayangan lembut, bukan tone surface.

### Use

```css
/* var(--elevation-0) */
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `elevation-0` | none | Elemen datar: kartu outlined, list. |
| `elevation-1` | 0px 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0px 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06) · dark: 0px 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0px 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.4) | Kartu standar di atas surface putih. |
| `elevation-2` | 0px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0px 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.08) · dark: 0px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0px 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5) | Menu, dropdown, kartu yang ditekan. |
| `elevation-3` | 0px 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0px 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.12) · dark: 0px 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0px 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.6) | FAB, dialog, bottom sheet. |
| `elevation-4` | 0px -2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08) · dark: 0px -2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.6) | Bar aksi menempel di bawah layar (bayangan ke atas). |
| `elevation-5` | 0px 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.14), 0px 24px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.12) · dark: 0px 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), 0px 24px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.6) | Elemen yang sedang di-drag atau di-swipe. |
